representation_fit.evidence: Brief shape=open-collection, job=locate item in unbounded large collection; impl is a list+detail locator over 2,180 items with faceted narrowing — screenshots (1280x860, 1440x900) show item rows with MPN/value/stock plus count badges on every category, family, and facet chip; app.js:1-10 declares PAT-LIST-DETAIL filter-first

primary_task_salience.evidence: Search bar is the widest element in the header at both viewports with placeholder 'Search parts — mpn, value, description…' and '/' hint; results list occupies the center pane and is focused on load (app.js:457); status bar advertises the locate loop '/ search ↑↓ move ↵ inspect Esc clear' (index.html:72-74)

time_to_understand.evidence: Initial screen self-labels its regions (COLLECTION, INSPECTOR, breadcrumb 'All parts › no category scope') and state ('2,180 of 2,180 parts · 0 filters active', screenshots 1280x860/1440x900); grouped list header 'Capacitors › Ceramic MLCC 120' explains list composition at a glance

navigation_cost.evidence: Locate ≤3 interactions holds on all structural paths: query (1 interaction, app.js:111), or category (1, app.js:203) → family (2, app.js:217) → item select (3, app.js:334-337); facet chips narrow in 1 (app.js:245); detail is a persistent pane, not a navigation step (app.js:341-378); deep-link ?q=&cat=&fam= supported (app.js:435-440)

context_loss.evidence: Explicit context rule 'query and filters compose (AND) and NEVER reset' (app.js:7-9); breadcrumb shows removable per-filter chips + Clear all (app.js:139-157); selection survives narrowing and is annotated '✓ in current narrowing / ⚠ outside current narrowing' with 'Show in its home context' instead of dropped (app.js:352-357); empty state says 'Your context is kept — nothing was lost' (index.html:57); inspector empty note 'detail never replaces context' visible in both screenshots

ui_surface_complexity.evidence: Six permanent surfaces (header, crumbs, rail, results, inspector, status bar) all serve the locate job; facet chips capped at 14 per facet (app.js:232); no extraneous features (no accounts/settings/persistence). Deduction: rail density is high — 16+ chips visible at 1280x860 (Package group ×8, Mount ×2, Tolerance ×6) — proportionate but heavy for a single main screen

accessibility.evidence: Receipt fails 4/7 checks: a11y.contrast, a11y.focus_order, a11y.target_size, type.min_projected_size (measurement-summary.json checks). Source shows genuine effort — :focus-visible outline (styles.css:38-42), listbox with aria-activedescendant (index.html:60, app.js:281), aria-pressed/aria-expanded on all filters (app.js:179,194,201,215), aria-live status (index.html:71) — but measured outcomes fail; small targets corroborated in source: q-clear 20×20px (styles.css:101), chev 6×4px padding (styles.css:198-205), path buttons 1×4px padding (styles.css:334-337); 11px counts/kbd/headers (styles.css:44,171,218) consistent with the type-size failure

frontend_rework.evidence: All layout checks pass — layout.overflow, layout.responsive_collision, text.truncation (measurement-summary.json); neither screenshot shows a visible defect at 1280x860 or 1440x900; target_invalid:false validates the receipt. The 4 failures are a11y/type, implying accessibility remediation work rather than layout rework

acceptance_seed_coverage.evidence: Seed '定位路径有搜索/过滤支撑且不丢上下文': search across mpn/value/desc with precomputed haystack (data.js:249-255, app.js:52-67), AND-composed filters with live per-facet counts (app.js:56-96, 226-250), context never auto-reset (app.js:161-166 clearAll is user-invoked only), removable chips keep narrowing visible (app.js:139-149), selection annotated not dropped (app.js:352-357)

defects_observed: a11y.contrast: fail (measurement-summary.json) despite styles.css:3 claiming 'AA contrast on all text pairs'
a11y.focus_order: fail (measurement-summary.json); listbox navigation is a global document keydown (app.js:412-430) while option rows carry no tabindex of their own

a11y.target_size: fail (measurement-summary.json); consistent with 20×20px clear button (styles.css:99-105), 6×4px chevron padding (styles.css:198-205), 1×4px inspector path buttons (styles.css:334-337)
type.min_projected_size: fail (measurement-summary.json); 11px mono counts/kbd and 11px rail headers (styles.css:44,168-173,217-223), 12px meta/desc/chip text (styles.css:229,274-275)
scores.overall_note: impl-20 is a tightly scoped list-detail locator that matches the brief's open-collection/locate shape almost exactly: a 2,180-part inlined catalog (data.js:264-269) renders ready at first paint via classic scripts with no loading state observable (index.html:81-82, app.js:443-457), satisfying the usability-at-load constraint. The acceptance seed is fully covered — search, faceted narrowing with counts, and an explicit never-reset context rule (app.js:7-9) with breadcrumb chips and annotated out-of-scope selections. Locate paths stay within the brief's three-interaction budget on every structural route. The one clear weakness is accessibility: the sanitized receipt fails a11y.contrast, a11y.focus_order, a11y.target_size, and type.min_projected_size (3 pass / 4 fail, target_invalid:false), and the source corroborates undersized targets and small type even though semantic ARIA and focus-visible styling are present. Layout is defect-free in both screenshots and all three layout checks pass, so remaining work would be accessibility remediation rather than structural rework. These judgments are from screenshots, source, and the receipt only; task time, retrieval accuracy, and human preference are not observable in this blind pilot, and model-judged legibility here is not a substitute for human preference.
